The centred sheet `.sheet-wrap` is fixed with z-index 30 (styles.css:957) and its backdrop covers the bottom-left where toasts sit; the help/manual overlays use z-index 40-41 (packages/web/src/panels/hiw.css:5,74,93). So any toast fired while a sheet is open (an in-tray action that fails, a key-result mark, a counter) is hidden under the sheet. Fix: give `.toasts` a z-index above every overlay (e.g. 50, and note it in the comment at styles.css:114 alongside the minimap/hud note) and move `<Toasts />` to the last child of `.app` in app.tsx so DOM order agrees; check nothing else (`.layout-bar` z 20, `.help-tip` z 41) needs to sit above a toast. Keep toasts pointer-events as they are so the sheet stays usable behind them.
